title: Live two-tab multiplayer Playwright smoke + MP HUD peer count
notes: S109 + S112 shipped the multiplayer foundation + recipe sync; the live two-tab verification has been a 'manual smoke' gap since then. S114 closes that gap with a Playwright spec + a small HUD enhancement.
Out of scope: server-side bots/bombs/blasts/pickups (next major MP chunk, tracked for a later sprint).

stories.title: Playwright two-tab smoke verifies remote bombers walk + recipe sync works
stories.summary:
New tests/e2e spec that boots the Node reference world server, opens TWO browser contexts pointing at kaboom-crew with distinct ?playerId= + ?recipe= params, presses movement keys in tab A, then verifies tab B sees the remote bomber's Transform.position update. Skipped on CI without a long-running ws server unless the test starts one (spawn node-world-server in setup hook).

Also verifies the S112 recipe sync: the local recipe in tab A propagates to a CharacterRecipe component on the player.<A> snapshot entity visible in tab B (queryable via /__agf/snapshot or window.__agf).
verification: acceptance: Playwright e2e test verifies the full S109+S112 multiplayer pipeline end-to-end on two browser contexts. Spawns node-world-server in a subprocess on a random port, opens 2 tabs pointing at kaboom-crew with distinct ?playerId= + ?recipe= params, waits for both to see each other in the snapshot, presses KeyD in tab A, asserts tab B sees alpha's Transform.position.x advance past 0.1, asserts the bravo snapshot contains a CharacterRecipe component with alpha's encoded recipe blob, asserts alpha's HUD shows 'Multiplayer: 1 peer(s) online'. Passes cleanly on both chromium and chromium-preview profiles.
tests/e2e/kaboom-multiplayer-roundtrip.spec.ts: NEW (~170 LOC) — modelled on tests/e2e/multiclient-roundtrip.spec.ts (beacon-world pattern), with kaboom-crew-specific recipe + HUD assertions
Modelled on beacon-world's multiclient-roundtrip but kaboom-specific

stories.title: Multiplayer HUD: connected peers indicator under the existing stats panel
stories.summary: Small UX win on the existing renderConnectivityHint surface. When networked=true, the kaboom-crew HUD adds a single line `Multiplayer: N peer(s) online` derived from the snapshot's `player.*` Presence entities (minus the local player). Hidden in single-player mode. Pure derivative — no protocol changes, no system changes — bench-reads the live ECS world.
verification: acceptance: HUD stats panel adds 'Multiplayer: N peer(s) online' line when networked and at least one remote bomber is in the snapshot. api.status() exposes remotePeers count derived from entities carrying the RemoteBomberOwned component (stamped by the decorator system). Single-player suppresses the line — no visual clutter.
examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts: api.status() now includes remotePeers count; HUD stats lines conditionally appends 'Multiplayer: N peer(s) online'.
